_doc: Light inside buildings (EnvironmentController, PoiBuilder's interior probes; ADR-0050). Each room rectangle's reflection probe replaces the sky's ambient with a flat fill, because SDFGI leaves rooms near black. By day the fill is day_fill of day_color (dimmed by overcast_dim under full cloud); at night it is night_share of the outdoor night's ambient (the moon's or the Hum's colour, through the windows), never below night_floor, so a dark room still shows its shapes against what a lamp lights. While the eye is inside a room the exposure opens by exposure_day (by day) or exposure_night (at night), eased over adapt_seconds: the doorway blooms a little and the room reads, as an eye adapts.
